nodes.label: Silueta (Default User Avatar)
nodes.description: A dark silhouette of a person (male figure, head and shoulders) against a plain white background. This is a generic placeholder/default avatar image used in the application's user profile system when no profile photo is available. The silhouette is entirely black/very dark, showing no facial features, serving as an anonymous stand-in for user profile pictures.
nodes.design_purpose: Default avatar / fallback profile image for users who have not uploaded a personal photo. Commonly displayed in profile cards, headers, and user listings when the real user image is absent.
visual_elements: Solid dark/black fill with no facial detail
Neutral, gender-ambiguous but slightly male-presenting shape
